messages:
alex_dev: Heads up, CI on main is red — macos-worker job failed on the packaging step with a KMS decrypt error. Anyone able to triage? logs below

alex_dev: ```
[2026-03-17 09:12:03] ERROR: KMS.Decrypt failed: permission_denied: Request had insufficient authentication scopes
stack: google.api_core.exceptions.PermissionDenied: 403 Permission denied for service-account: repo-maint@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

ops-bot: automated summary: build #4242 failed on macos-latest — packaging — exit 1 — logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4242

liya_sre: ping @alex_dev can you paste the exact failing command and which key it uses? I'll check IAM binding.

alex_dev: it's running `./scripts/package_mac.sh` which calls `gcloud kms decrypt --key=my-ci-key --location=global --keyring=infra` token in env var `CI_REPO_TOKEN` fetched via gha-secret-sync.

sam_build: could be the short-lived OIDC token expiry. Did we rotate the repo-maint SA? I saw a rollout yesterday.

alex_dev: i don't think we rotated it, but the error shows a refresh error in the trace. full snippet: 

alex_dev: ```
caused_by: google.auth.exceptions.RefreshError: ('invalid_grant', 'Token has been expired or revoked')
```

jen_pm: do we have someone who can rerun the workflow manually? we need to know if it's flaky or systemic before we bisect.

liya_sre: I'll check KMS IAM & SA bindings now. If it's a revoked token we need to re-provision the credential. @sam_build can you attempt a safe rerun (no deploy) and tag it non-prod?

sam_build: i can rerun. starting now.

ci-bot: Build rerun requested by sam_build — run id #4243 — non-prod rerun.

alex_dev: packaging step uses secrets pulled by gha-secret-sync action which uses the repo-maint SA oauth token; maybe the token lease expired in the sync.

liya_sre: looked at IAM: repo-maint@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com still has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on my-ci-key. No revokes. I'll check the credential's oauth tokens and the secret-sync job logs.

liya_sre: secret-sync logs show `Refreshing token failed: 401 invalid_token` at 09:10:05 — probably the SA key was rotated and the long-lived token revoked.

jen_pm: who owns the repo-maint key rotation? @alex_dev?

alex_dev: ops team rotated a service key last week (deprecation) but it was supposed to be updated. I'll open an incident and assign to ops.

sam_build: rerun finished — macos job failed again with same decrypt error.

alex_dev: ok that's consistent — not flaky. bisect would be noise. liya, if token was revoked, what's the fix? re-provision sync with new key or swap to OIDC.

liya_sre: temporary fix: we can create a new service-account key and update the secret-store, trigger secret-sync. Better long-term: switch gha-secret-sync to Workload Identity / OIDC to avoid long-lived keys. I'll draft a PR for that and also provision a hotfix to unblock CI.

liya_sre: PR draft: refs #987 — will request review from @alex_dev and @sam_build. In meantime, who can manually push the new token to secrets? ops-bot?

ops-bot: ops runbook step: create new service-account key, upload to vault at secret path `secret/ci/repo-maint`, then trigger secret-sync. Confirm before doing prod.

jen_pm: yes, do it. please post the runbook steps in the PR so SRE can follow.

liya_sre: I've provisioned a new key and triggered secret-sync in staging. posting logs.

liya_sre: staging sync succeeded at 09:37. Triggering prod sync now.

ci-bot: prod secret-sync job completed — success — token rotated.

sam_build: rerunning CI now.

ci-bot: Build rerun requested by sam_build — run id #4245.

ci-bot: Build #4245 passed on macos-worker — packaging OK. All checks green.

alex_dev: thanks y'all. liya please keep the PR to switch to OIDC in the backlog, and open a retrospective note about key rotation visibility.

jen_pm: closing the loop. :thumbsup:
